result: {"decisions":[{"point":"D1","problem":"How to choose which of many candidate research problems to work on next, given limited capacity and an abundance of ideas.","did":"Maintained an append-only ideas file and, between projects, skimmed it and picked whichever idea seemed most interesting or important at that moment.","alternatives_named":["find something new entirely if nothing looks compelling","passing projects off to lab members"],"stated_reason":"As an independent contributor he can only work on a few things at a time, so each choice means not doing something else; his problem is filtering ideas, not generating them.","quote":"When it's time to pick my next project, I skim through the list, and pick whichever I think is most interesting. or exciting. or important. or whatever I'm looking for at the moment."}]}
